text:
ryan_marketing: Morning team 1 1 Draft for the product launch blog is ready for a short review: https://docs.google.com/document/d/REDACTED. Need signoff on: hero sentence, benchmark callout (p50/p95 + cost), webinar CTA + final UTM string. Target publish Thu 04/02 09:00 PT.

mira_pm: Quick skim 1 love the narrative. One request: avoid absolute "fastest" claims. If we want to highlight latency give p50/p95 and the workload context (small-batch vs heavy throughput).

devin_eng: Can confirm numbers for small-batch: p50 ~38ms, p95 ~110ms. Avg token cost for the test harness: $0.00035/token. I'll paste the exact shell command we used to collect this in the doc.

nora_ops: For registration flow, please use this UTM pattern: `/webinar/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q2` Also make sure HubSpot mapping sets lead.source=blog and lead.campaign=optimize_launch_q2.

jess_legal: FYI: avoid comparative adjectives like "industry-leading" unless you have comparative citations. "Production-grade" or "enterprise-ready" are safer. Also cleared on "Redwood-verified" for the benchmarks image caption if you include our internal report link.

pr-bot: PR tracker updated: Row 18 added (ryan_marketing) https://sheets.re/redwood/marketing

ryan_marketing: Updated draft to swap "industry-leading" -> "production-grade" and added the UTM string. Embedding Devin's figures now. Two tiny asks before I lock: 1) Devin, can you export a 600x180 png of the benchmark sparkline? 2) Jess, confirm "Redwood-verified" clearance for the caption (if not I'll remove).

devin_eng: Exporting now. Will add a one-line cache stat too: prefix KV cache hit ~34% (30d). PNG and numbers in the doc by EOD.

jess_legal: Confirmed for caption use in marketing assets (non-comparative). :white_check_mark: No trademark issues.

mira_pm: Looks good. Suggest a tiny CTA tweak: "Join the launch webinar to see the numbers and Q&A" -> "Join our launch webinar for a short demo + live Q&A" (more explicit).

ryan_marketing: Love that. I'll make the CTA change, drop the chart into the doc, and lock copy by 6pm. I'll schedule the publish and webinar invite after locking. Thanks all :rocket:
